jobs.resolve.note: Add a job looks the address up when it is typed and offers to open the job already in the workspace; `source_key` serves collectors and scripts.

sources.run.note: Run once, also for one source, sends a bulk action.

sources.delete.note: Remove, also for one source, sends a bulk action.

applications.staleness_list.note: Rows use `stale_inputs`, `stale_changes` and `stale_changes_total` in the application list; details use the per-application report. There is no workspace-wide staleness view.

jobs.create.note: Add a job sends the address, role, company, location and pasted text; other details are corrected afterwards as keys and values (`jobs.update`). `raw`, `source_key` and `source_id` are collector fields for scripted imports.

applications.create.note: Starting an application sends the job only; plan fields and questions are edited afterwards (`applications.update`).

contexts.create.note: The context dialog sends `template_ids`; `template_id` is the single-template form of the same input.

documents.create.note: Add a document and New revision send the title, frozen copy, note, the CV or letter's source and PDF, or form content; the agent cites `claim_ids` and `knowledge_ids`, which an open revision shows as counts.

profile.update.note: `metadata` is edited as rows under Other details; the owner's rules and facts are items of the Policy. Target roles and preferences are decision items of the Policy.

templates.update.note: The Rules tab edits the typed limits, the rule statements and the free-form rest of `rules` as rows.

applications.update.note: Answers have one control per question on the review page. The response form moves the stage with `response_date` and `response_note` (Other uses `responses.add`), and closes as no reply with `concluded_on`.

applications.list.note: The Preparing and Ready chips filter Draft by `ready=false` and `ready=true`; the Ready to apply queue filters by `readiness=ready` with `sort=ready`; Waiting for a reply and Close as no reply use `no_reply_due`. The other time ranges serve agents and scripts.

responses.add.note: The response form builds its body in `pages/applications/recording.ts`, which sends `kind`, `date` and `note`; the Timeline's Record a response opens the same form.

contexts.list.note: Inputs lists the application's frozen copies 20 at a time; `q` serves agents and scripts.

templates.list.note: Templates and the frozen-copy dialog read the templates as one page of summaries; `offset` serves agents and scripts.

insights.read.note: Insights uses the default minimum sample of 5 and `applied_since` for the last 90 days; `min_sample` and `applied_until` serve agents and scripts.

runs.start.note: Runs belong to API tokens: a dashboard session has no runs. Activity shows runs, their reports and their changes read-only.

runs.update.note: Runs belong to API tokens: a dashboard session has no runs.

runs.finish.note: Runs belong to API tokens: a dashboard session has no runs.

events.list.note: The Activity timeline filters changes by who made them (owner, API tokens or one token, system, not recorded), by kind of record (`subject_types`), by period and by run; the job, application and subject filters serve agents and scripts; the job and application timelines read `timeline.read`.

runs.list.note: Activity filters runs by status; Today lists the runs active since the last visit (`active_since`). The workflow, token and start-time filters serve agents and scripts.

questions.list.note: Today and Activity filter questions by state; `answered_since` and the subject filters serve the agent's next run.

questions.ask.note: Agents ask questions for the owner; the dashboard answers and withdraws them.

requests.take.note: Agents take, complete and decline requests with an API token; the dashboard writes and withdraws them.

requests.complete.note: Agents take, complete and decline requests with an API token; the dashboard writes and withdraws them.

requests.decline.note: Agents take, complete and decline requests with an API token; the dashboard writes and withdraws them.

requests.list.note: Activity filters requests by state and the Ask your agent dialog by subject; `run_id` and `updated_since` serve agents.

notes.list.note: The job and application timelines list every note with its scope, author, run and pin.

applications.history.note: The application's Timeline lists its events with its notes and its job's entries.

timeline.read.note: The timelines filter by kind (notes, changes, responses), who, scope (on an application) and period, and page by 30; `limit` up to 200 serves agents and scripts.

requests.read.note: Activity renders requests from the list, which returns complete records.

questions.read.note: Activity renders questions from the list, which returns complete records.

policy.add.note: The form sends the fields it shows; `position` and `idempotency_key` serve agents and scripts (a new item goes to the end, then the arrows move it).

policy.read.note: The screen reads the whole policy; `GET /policy/{section}` serves agents that need one section.

runs.read.note: The report counts all changes of a run and names the records of the first 100 (`changes_limit`); its link opens the timeline filtered by the run, which pages through every change. `changes_offset` serves agents and scripts.

jobs.list.note: Jobs filters by tab (queue), search, signal, text completeness, who dismissed and rule, and the All tab by company, place, source, work style and added from; `posting_language`, `posting_language_not`, `requires`, `job_type`, `remote` and `created_until` also serve agents and scripts.

jobs.update.note: Correct the job edits role, company, place, address, text and the other details as keys and values. Whether the source still lists the posting is the no_longer_listed signal.

jobs.duplicates.note: A job's Possible copies lists its group at the default confidence; `queue`, `match_location` and `offset` page the workspace-wide list for agents and scripts.

files.list.note: A job's Files lists all of its files; `q` serves agents and scripts.

collection.yield.note: Yield offers the last 30 or 90 days and all time (`since`); `until` and `min_sample` serve agents and scripts.
